consumer: The frontend tile renderer reading each tile's per-tile visibility value, asking 'is this tile remembered but not currently visible, so it should be drawn with the dimmed memory shading rather than bright?'
scope: the nearby tile region within the export radius around the avatar (per-tile, map-region reach)
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles (seen) — its body writes each tile's ter/furn ids plus a 'seen' value taken from ctx.m.pl_sees(p, ctx.radius), the per-tile player-visibility flag the renderer uses to choose currently-visible vs remembered-dimmed shading
divergence: A tile the avatar saw earlier and still remembers (terrain id populated) but cannot currently see: correct export carries seen=false (renders dimmed); a wrong answer reporting seen=true would render it bright as if currently visible, exposing the error
